en.hubeali:
Hareyz, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When he extracts it (Zakāt) from his wealth, so it gets wasted, and he had not specified it for anyone, so he is not accountable for it’.
en.sarwar: 3. Hariz has narrated from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If one takes away Zakat from his assets but does not name the beneficiary and it is lost, he is free from his obligation.’”
